draft.strengthQuote: Good separation speed racing over the top.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.18, the 95th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 11th of 28 at WR. He lasted until pick 162, well after his grade rank (95th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Tavon Austin. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 855 receiving yards in 2021, 18th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 22 career games and 1 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 0 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2024.
